description: Pyrite Cloud is a serverless application deployment platform for building, deploying, and scaling apps without managing infrastructure. Its public site and docs describe platform features and a command-line workflow for managing projects, services, and deployments.
summary: pyrite.cloud exposes a documented Pyrite CLI (`pyrite`) for deployment and environment management, authenticated via interactive GitHub OAuth login; no public HTTP/GraphQL/MCP developer API surface or machine-readable spec was found.
